method: Exact full .08 finite opaque extrusion retained. A z/y course-aware normal and material field continues paired stone courses through both entire collars and caps. Wider interior vertex-weight blend smooths into accepted stone mesh normals. Normalize after interpolation, after blend, after proper object NORMAL transform. Actual graph parameters and independent linked-graph evaluation retained. New field has zero longitudinal x derivative, matching y/z derivatives and actual radiance under all4. No old field values treated as locks.
